title: The Latest Crier for Oct 14, 2026
items:
Fellowship of Christian Athletes - Tomorrow!

YOU’RE INVITED! 
Join FCA tomorrow, 10/13 , for an all-ministry Worship Night at 8pm around the fire pit near the pond. We hope to see you there to enjoy worship with other students and smores! 

Next Week: 

We will NOT be meeting the following Tuesday, 10/20 , due to fall break. Have a great week! 

- FCA Leadership Team
